description: List the 52 CAPTCHA and bot-challenge types EveryInfra solves. **Call it before everyinfra_solve_captcha** to get three things: the type name, the required/optional params, and **the shape of the solution** (token / cookie / text / number / fields / points / boxes / tokens / indices — a string to submit, coordinates to click yourself, or grid cells to click: each is used differently). Free.

type.description: Optional; only this type, e.g. turnstile / recaptcha_v2 / cloudflare_challenge

name: everyinfra_list_captcha_types
title: List CAPTCHA types
